name: Seth Rice
description:
With more than 30 years of experience in the construction industry, including the last 10 years dedicated exclusively to masonry, I bring a wealth of knowledge and craftsmanship to every project. Over two years ago, I made the decision to branch out on my own, allowing me to take full responsibility for every aspect of my work and deliver the highest level of quality possible.


By working independently, I am able to personally oversee each project from start to finish, ensuring exceptional attention to detail and craftsmanship throughout. Whether reshaping flower beds or creating intricate paver designs and custom cuts, I take the time necessary to get every detail right.


I believe that reputation is everything, which is why I prioritize transparency, communication, and customer satisfaction on every job. My business has grown entirely through word-of-mouth referrals, and I am proud to have a long list of satisfied clients who are happy to speak about both my work and character.


I use only high-quality materials, build to meet industry structural standards, and focus on creating installations that are both beautiful and built to last. As a father of two amazing children, I am motivated every day to work hard, uphold my values, and deliver results that my clients can enjoy for years to come.
